segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I am from the cyber cell. A complaint has been opened in your name.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: What complaint? I have not heard about this.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Your identity was linked to an illegal transfer. You are under investigation.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Do not tell your family or end this call until we clear your name.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: Can I call the official office to verify this?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No. Transfer your savings to our verification account now to avoid arrest.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I will not transfer money. I will contact the official number myself.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: This is the public help desk returning your message about a threatening call.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: Someone claimed I was under digital arrest.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: You said that caller linked your identity to a criminal case.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: You can end any such call and contact the official office or someone you trust.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: So I should check through an official number?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes. We will not ask you to move money or share a banking code over the phone.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: Thanks. I will verify it independently.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: A parcel booked with your phone number has been held at our depot.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I was not expecting any parcel.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Customs flagged it for a prohibited item.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The case will be sent to police today if you disconnect and delay.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: Can I check the tracking number first?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Pay the release fee to the account I give you now to stop the case.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I will not pay on this call. Goodbye.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I am nearby with your parcel. You can confirm it in your shopping app.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: Yes, I see the order there.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I can meet you at the building entrance when you are ready.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: At the door, please share the delivery code shown for this order.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I am at the door. My order app shows delivery code 4821.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Thanks, marked delivered. I do not need a bank OTP, card PIN, or payment.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I have the parcel. Thank you.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I am calling from your bank's verification team about your KYC status.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I thought my profile was already updated.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Your account will be frozen today unless this update is completed.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Read the banking OTP you just received so I can finish the KYC update.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: That sounds unsafe. Why do you need it?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: If you wait to visit a branch, your account may be blocked first.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I will not share it. I will call my bank.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Your bank profile may need a KYC review this month.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: What should I do?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Please check the notice in your bank app or ask at your branch.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Never share your OTP or PIN, including with me.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: So you will not update it during this call?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Correct. Verify the deadline through the bank's published support number.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I will check the app. Thanks.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: This is the card security desk calling about your blocked card.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I did have a transaction declined.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: A large transaction was attempted. We can release the block right now.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Tell me your card PIN and the banking OTP so I can unblock it.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I do not share those details on calls.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Calling the number on the card will take too long to stop this transaction.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I will use my bank app instead.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: A card transaction was declined, and you may want to review it.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I just saw a decline notification.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: You can check or freeze the card yourself in your bank app.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: If you need help, call the number printed on the back of your card.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: Do you need my card number first?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No. Please do not share your PIN, OTP, or full card number with me.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I will check the app. Thank you.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I am calling from the telecom regulator about your mobile number.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: What is wrong with my number?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Your SIM will be disconnected within an hour because of a complaint.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Install the support app I name and give me remote access to keep it active.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I do not want anyone controlling my phone.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Do not contact your mobile provider until I finish this verification.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I will call my provider directly.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: This is a reminder to check your mobile plan's service notice.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: Is my SIM being disconnected?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: You can see its actual status in your provider's app or at its store.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: If the notice does not appear there, please ignore this call.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: Do I need to install anything for you?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No. We will not ask for a remote-control app or banking code.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I will check the app. Goodbye.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Your electricity bill is overdue, according to our records.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I paid a bill recently.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: A technician is scheduled to disconnect your power in one hour.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Send the bill amount to the personal UPI account I give you right now.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: Can I check the utility portal?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The portal will update too late to stop the technician.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I will contact the utility directly.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Your latest electricity statement is available.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I thought I had already paid it.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Please check the amount and due date in your utility account or printed bill.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Any service notice will also appear through the utility's published channels.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: Can I pay you over the phone?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No. I cannot take a transfer, card number, or OTP during this call.

segments.speaker: listener
segments.text: I will check my account. Thank you.
